title: High electricity intensity detected
evidence: Average daily consumption: 1979 kWh (232.9 Wh/sqm/day). This is above the efficient benchmark of 100 Wh/sqm/day.
suggested_action: Audit HVAC schedules, lighting, and equipment. Consider installing occupancy-based controls and LED upgrades.
expected_impact: Estimated 10% reduction could save ~198 kWh/day (₹1583/day). This is an estimate based on typical efficiency gains.
calculation_method: Intensity = avg_daily_kwh / area_sqm * 1000. Saving = 10% of avg consumption × ₹8.0/kWh.

title: High off-hours electricity consumption
evidence: Off-hours (22:00-06:00) average: 14.9 kWh/hr, which is 42% of peak-hours average (35.3 kWh/hr).
suggested_action: Review electricity schedules for off-hours. Check HVAC, lighting, and equipment shutdown procedures.
expected_impact: 30% reduction in off-hours could save ~36 kWh/night (₹285/night). This is an estimate.
calculation_method: Off-hours ratio = off_hours_mean / peak_hours_mean. Saving = 30% × off_mean × 8 hours × ₹8.0.
